from pathlib import Path
import struct

def box(t,p): return struct.pack('>I4s',8+len(p),t.encode())+p
ftyp=box('ftyp', b'isom\x00\x00\x02\x00isomiso2')
# minimal init with one track and one sample, plus fragment
mvhd=box('mvhd', b'\x00'*100)
tkhd=box('tkhd', struct.pack('>I',0)+struct.pack('>IIII',0,0,1,0)+struct.pack('>I',1)+struct.pack('>II',0,0)+struct.pack('>hhhhhh',0,0,0,0,0,0)+b'\x00'*36+struct.pack('>II',0,0))
mdhd=box('mdhd', struct.pack('>I',0)+struct.pack('>IIII',0,0,90000,1)+struct.pack('>H',0x55c4)+struct.pack('>H',0))
hdlr=box('hdlr', struct.pack('>I',0)+b'vide'+b'\x00'*12+b'VideoHandler\x00')
url=box('url ', struct.pack('>I',1))
dref=box('dref', struct.pack('>II',0,1)+url)
dinf=box('dinf', dref)
stsd=box('stsd', struct.pack('>II',0,1)+b'\x00'*8)
stts=box('stts', struct.pack('>II',0,1)+struct.pack('>II',1,1))
stsc=box('stsc', struct.pack('>II',0,1)+struct.pack('>III',1,1,1))
stsz=box('stsz', struct.pack('>IIII',0,0,1,4)+struct.pack('>I',4))
stco=box('stco', struct.pack('>II',0,1)+struct.pack('>I',0))
stbl=box('stbl', stsd+stts+stsc+stsz+stco)
minf=box('minf', dinf+stbl)
mdia=box('mdia', mdhd+hdlr+minf)
trak=box('trak', tkhd+mdia)
moov=box('moov', mvhd+trak)
mfhd=box('mfhd', struct.pack('>II',0,1))
tfhd=box('tfhd', struct.pack('>II',0x020000,1))
tfdt=box('tfdt', struct.pack('>IQ',1,0))
trun=box('trun', struct.pack('>III',0x000001,1,0))
traf=box('traf', tfhd+tfdt+trun)
moof=box('moof', mfhd+traf)
mdat=box('mdat', b'AAAA')
Path('/tmp/poc9.bin').write_bytes(ftyp+moov+moof+mdat)
print('wrote', len((ftyp+moov+moof+mdat)))
